raw_result.task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack or beverage by picking up a light object from the kitchen and pass it to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing furniture if needed and receive the snack or beverage from R1 to place it on the table.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the bedroom is tidy and assist in passing any light objects if needed.
central_instructions.R4: Check the bathroom for cleanliness and assist in passing any light objects if needed.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]

[5-10 min]

- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1. (r2_s1)

[10-15 min]

- R2 [LOCAL] Assess the living room layout to identify any furniture that needs rearranging for optimal seating. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a cozy seating area. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]

- R1 [PASS] Bring snacks or beverages to the living room. (r1_s1)

[10-15 min]

- R2 [LOCAL] Place the snacks or beverages on the coffee table. (r2_s5)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]

[5-10 min]

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the dresser is tidy and free of clutter. (r3_s3)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Check the bathroom surfaces for cleanliness. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Open the cabinet to inspect for any light objects like a spray bottle or toilet paper. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [PASS] Pass a spray bottle to another robot if needed for cleaning. (r4_s3)
- R4 [PASS] Pass toilet paper to another robot if needed for restocking. (r4_s4)
